dbf_file.description: Path to the source XBase/FoxPro .dbf file to convert.

memo_file.description: Path to the associated FoxPro memo file (.fpt). Empty if none.

table_name.description: Name of the PostgreSQL table to create or populate.

create_table.description: Generate a CREATE TABLE statement. Defaults to true.

drop_table.description: Generate a DROP TABLE statement before creation. Defaults to true.

drop_if_exists.description: Use 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS' for PostgreSQL 8.2+ compatibility. Defaults to true.

truncate_table.description: Issue TRUNCATE TABLE to clear existing data. Incompatible with CREATE/DROP. Defaults to false.

use_transaction.description: Wrap the script in a transaction for atomic updates. Defaults to true.

quote_table_name.description: Enclose table name in quotes to handle reserved words. Defaults to true.

show_progress.description: Show a progress bar during conversion. Defaults to false.

numeric_as_numeric.description: Create NUMERIC fields as NUMERIC type. If false, creates as TEXT to handle invalid data. Defaults to true.

input_encoding.description: Source encoding for iconv conversion to UTF-8 (e.g., 'LATIN1'). Empty for no conversion.
